value.rationale: The first natural nonlatin double cover of prime-order dihedral quandles has a p-dimensional right-annihilator kernel and cannot be counted by prime-order formulas alone. The exact lift-eigenspace theorem resolves this obstruction uniformly over all odd finite fields, with genuinely different nonmodular Frobenius and modular behavior. It supplies structural and arithmetic information for coefficient-sensitive quandle algebra calculations beyond a small example.
